items.problem: Umsebenzi wombutho = the work/job of the organisation (umsebenzi is the word for work; a person who works is isisebenzi / abasebenzi). As a role label it does not name a person.
Ngaphambili means forward/ahead/in front, which reads like the opposite of Previous next to the Next step button.
Ngaphezulu means above / over, not the quantity More; reads as a direction.
Ngaphantsi means below / under, not the quantity Less; reads as a direction.
